authority: Fixed reviewed support metadata. inventory_arc_unpacker.py reads these explicit entries; it never infers support from upstream registrations, Rust filenames, templates, or string matches. Native FORMATS/registrations are checked only for agreement.

status_meaning.ported: Named native image variants have a concrete registered Rust implementation; listed limits and evidence still apply. This does not mean every title/layout is supported.
status_meaning.partial: Registered concrete implementation with an explicit variant/resource/codec or evidence boundary. Do not erase limits when regenerating inventory.
status_meaning.pending: No registered Rust implementation claimed. Upstream source presence alone never changes this state.

boundaries: No fixture binaries, user game data or fonts copied into CrySirror. Kaguya has synthetic ordinary tests matching upstream format construction rather than binary fixture distribution.
This is decoder capability, not registration of an original VM or proof an entire game runs.
Corrupt/truncated input and unsupported layouts fail explicitly; does not reproduce unsafe upstream zero-filled partial-read behavior.
QNT output padding and TLG/G00 prediction arithmetic preserve byte wrapping and sampling order.
AJP shared JPEG decoding differs from upstream libjpeg: observed corpus max RGB absolute difference3, alpha exact; no universal bit-exact JPEG claim.
JBP1 requires explicit quantization table flag; pinned upstream reads uninitialized tables when absent. Declared JBP1 depth24 only.
ERI supports original lossless transformation, not DCT/LOT; blocking degree1..10 and shared decoded/padded byte limits enforced.
Native reference names use UTF8 or strict Shift-JIS fallback. Reference reads go through context capability root; only typed NotFound means absent.
PB3 fixed format name/XOR constants and header-embedded tail keys are format algorithms, not per-title key tables.
ERI additive reference composition wraps RGB only and preserves base alpha, matching original AddSimple.

external_validation_summary.external_keys: Supplied in environment from the pinned upstream test arguments; neither values nor key-bearing argv logged.

boundaries: No universal or full-game compatibility claim: only tested layouts, source variants, and explicit errors listed.
EAGLS GR implements the pinned fixed offset/key/LCG variant; the source notes other titles use different schemes.
AKB original global VFS stem search is constrained to authored sibling plus conventional akb/AKB/bmp/BMP names in the current capability directory; no global enumeration or other roots.
JPEG/WebP use maintained standard codecs; lossy rounding is not pixel-identical to the old native library goldens. CMYK JPEG has not been asserted as a legacy raw-channel equivalent.
DDS decoding produces the original padded top mip image for DXT; it is not a cubemap/volume/texture-array importer.
TGA interleave bits retain the pinned implementation row order; the original computes but does not apply interleave.

ordinary_validation.fixtures: Built in Rust memory from explicit binary fields and independently specified RGBA; no binary fixture committed.

external_validation_summary.fixture_policy: Fixtures remain external under the pinned reference checkout; no images, encoded fixture bytes or fonts are copied into the project. Their presence in upstream does not establish redistribution rights.

boundaries: Majiro RCT original CRC32/password-to-derived-XOR cipher is implemented through ctx.key("majiro/rct"). Passwords are caller-provided raw bytes, not guessed encodings or bundled game keys; unavailable client keys fail. The encrypted branch is behavior-tested with an independent synthetic ciphertext, not an external game-key fixture.
YKG supports the same unencrypted reversed-PNG form as pinned upstream; encrypted/non-PNG forms explicitly fail.
GFB palette/8-bit mode was unsupported in pinned upstream and remains rejected. PGD GE accepts only the implemented filters2 and3.
BJR filename transforms and filename-derived Cronus delta keys are verified for ASCII basenames only; non-ASCII filenames fail rather than guessing UTF8/CP932/native-char signedness.

RCT base names retain their byte interpretation as UTF8 capability paths; non-UTF8 names fail instead of guessing CP932. Non-ASCII base names have no external fixture validation. Optional missing base/mask/palette follows typed NotFound only; missing resolver, denied reads and corrupt nested images fail.
RCT mask lookup tries the conventional sibling stem_.rc8 then stem_.rct; it does not enumerate an ambient global stem index as upstream VirtualFileSystem did.
KG malformed/truncated alpha channels fail instead of upstream per-game exception suppression; KG images require at least two pixels as the native bitstream always writes two seeds.

Unknown compression/pixel variants, invalid offsets, unsupported versions and malformed/truncated streams fail. Where upstream returned partially zero-filled output after malformed compression, this port generally rejects that malformed stream.
Generic image output does not claim to migrate VM-specific animation, pivots or region playback semantics; original VMs remain separate.

ordinary_validation.fixtures: All ordinary binary data constructed in Rust memory; expected RGBA is explicit. No encoded fixture file committed.
coverage: PGX opaque/alpha behavior and JPEG APP3 embedded PGX.
GTF native DXT1 block through shared native-compatible decoder.
GIM RGBA8888 linear/swizzled, exact low-bit RGB565/RGBA5551/RGBA4444 conversion and unsupported indexed16 rejection.
XTX format0 ARGB tile conversion, format1 big-endian BGR565 full tile and half-tile opaque-black padding, plus existing registered BGI CBG integration smoke.
Malformed signatures, truncated PGX header-overlapping source range, unknown XTX format and multi-texture GTF rejection.

external_validation_summary.command: ARC_UNPACKER_SOURCE=<absolute pinned source checkout> cargo test -p crysirror-formats-arc --test images_d -- --ignored --nocapture
external_validation_summary.fixture_policy: Inputs and expected PNG remain in external pinned checkout, with no game/texture fixture bytes copied into the repository. Hashing/reading upstream fixtures does not establish redistribution rights.

boundaries: GIM supports direct formats0..3 and indexed4/8-bit formats4/5, with native 16x8 dimension rounding and swizzle. Indexed16/32 formats6/7 are explicitly rejected because their pinned upstream branches do not produce a working image.
GIM compressed chunks fail explicitly. Generic output retains native padded dimensions rather than inventing an unpadded crop.
GTF supports one 2D depth1 DXT1/3/5 texture, preserving native block-padded dimensions; multi-texture, 3D and non-DXT layouts fail.

XTX supports formats0/1/2, with optional small prefix, native tiling/endian conversion and crop; format2 uses DXT5. Offset/pivot fields are ignored as in the pinned image decoder, not interpreted as scene transforms.
JPEG-PGX extracts and decodes APP3 PGX payloads; it does not infer a JPEG-rendered fallback when native PGX data is malformed.
External XTX corpus covers formats0 and2. Format1 and GIM low-bit direct formats have explicit synthetic tests rather than external corpus evidence.
BGI CBG registration and implementation are separate from these five ports; the ordinary CBG smoke does not claim CBG was newly ported by this module.
No SDK, console hardware, GPU rendering, commercial-game execution or complete texture-container coverage is claimed.
